scene: Day 316, late afternoon in the depot yard, packed wall to wall with thousands of green walkers, every face turned up toward the loudspeaker under the canopy. Flat on his stomach on the canopy roof, the man in the red knit beanie stretches one mitten hand down over the edge toward the loudspeaker switch, a forest of raised green hands just below his fingers. In the foreground, at the bottom of the frame, Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye, orange backpack) clings to the gantry rail, eyes huge, one sweat drop, close to the camera. Tense because one slip puts his friend into the horde.

Day 307, dawn at a motorway junction at the edge of a city. The bridge, the slip road and the streets behind are all packed black with green walkers, and every one of them is turning at once toward the white truck at the bottom of the slip road; in the top window of a tall narrow house on the corner, a lamp is lit. In the foreground, Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye) leans out of the truck's driver window with his mitten hand pressed on the horn, eyes huge, one sweat drop, as the first walkers start down the slip road toward him. Tense because the whole city's horde is now coming for his truck.
